title: Command R Release
summary: Cohere introduced Command R on March 11, 2024 as a generative model aimed at scalable production workloads, with emphasis on retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, and long-context tasks.
significance: A dated launch milestone in Cohere's Command R model family, establishing the initial Command R announcement boundary without inferring ancestry or causal relationships.

verification.note: Cohere's first-party blog is dated March 11, 2024 and identifies the post as a Product Launch for Command R. Cohere's first-party release notes independently describe Command R as a new LLM for large-scale production workloads and document a 128K context window, RAG/tool-use focus, multilingual capabilities, and research/evaluation weights on Hugging Face. The release-notes page currently displays March 24, 2024, so it is used as corroborating evidence rather than to override the March 11 launch boundary. This candidate does not infer development geography, ancestry, influence, causality, universal priority, or relationship edges.
